title: System Facts Renderer Output
description: Formal JSON Schema contract for the render.json artifact written by playbooks/renderers/system_facts.yml. The renderer pulls a snapshot of live daemon facts via general_ludd.agent.gludd_facts and emits a fixed-shape document: a three-cell metric grid (running agents, completed today, success rate) followed by a per-model usage table. Every field is machine-checked; this file is the single source of truth for what the playbook MUST emit and what the renderer MUST consume.

title.title: Document Title
title.description: Human-readable heading rendered at the top of the dashboard page.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Ordered list of dashboard sections; exactly one metric_grid followed by exactly one table.

metadata.title: Render Metadata
metadata.description: Provenance block: when the artifact was generated and which renderer version produced it.

Metric.title: Metric
Metric.description: A single label/value/unit triple rendered as one card in the metric grid.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable name shown above the value.

value.title: Value
value.description: Numeric reading; type/range constrained by the containing prefixItem slot.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit suffix rendered next to the value; empty string means unitless.

MetricGridSection.title: Metric Grid Section
MetricGridSection.description: The three-card top-of-page grid: running agents, completed today, success rate - in that fixed order.

type.title: Section Type
type.description: Literal discriminator pinned to the metric_grid variant.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Exactly three metric cards in fixed order: Running agents, Completed today, Success rate.

prefixItems.title: Running Agents Metric
prefixItems.description: Live count of in-flight agents reported by gludd.work.running_agents.

value.title: Running Agents
value.description: Number of currently running agents; non-negative integer.

prefixItems.title: Completed Today Metric
prefixItems.description: Count of finished jobs reported by gludd.work.completed_today.

value.title: Completed Today
value.description: Number of jobs completed in the current UTC day; non-negative integer.

prefixItems.title: Success Rate Metric
prefixItems.description: Historical success rate reported by gludd.history.success_rate, expressed as a fraction in [0.0, 1.0].

value.title: Success Rate
value.description: Success fraction in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0]; rendered with a '%' unit suffix by convention.

ModelRow.title: Per-Model Usage Row
ModelRow.description: One row in the per-model usage table: model identifier, call count, and accumulated spend.

model.title: Model Identifier
model.description: Stable model name as reported by the daemon's /api/facts models map key.

calls.title: Call Count
calls.description: Number of dispatches recorded for this model; non-negative integer.

cost_usd.title: Accumulated Cost (USD)
cost_usd.description: Total spend on this model in US dollars; non-negative number. Optional because the daemon may omit cost telemetry for locally-served models.

TableSection.title: Per-Model Usage Table Section
TableSection.description: Table of per-model usage statistics sorted into one row per model.

type.title: Section Type
type.description: Literal discriminator pinned to the table variant.

columns.title: Column Names
columns.description: Ordered list of column names matching the row object keys.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Zero or more per-model usage rows.

Metadata.title: Render Metadata
Metadata.description: Provenance block: when the artifact was generated and which renderer version produced it.

generated_at.title: Generated At
generated_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking when the artifact was written.

playbook.title: Source Playbook
playbook.description: File stem of the renderer playbook that produced this artifact.

renderer_version.title: Renderer Version
renderer_version.description: Integer version of the renderer contract this artifact conforms to.

execution_ms.title: Execution Duration (ms)
execution_ms.description: Optional wall-clock execution time in milliseconds, populated by the runner after execution.
